motivation: After C_exec fixes many generic selection errors, history still changes no H/HS or H/Jm choices. Existing banks were generated current-only. Test aligned transition information in generation itself without repeating the legacy full-history versus current-only prompt comparison.
inputs: Authenticated observed prefix only; exact reversible code changes aligned to per-public-case before/after categorical outcomes; identical unchanged current/specification/current public feedback in all arms.

arms.HS: frozen permutation of complete source-bound prefix records with cards recomputed
arms.U: certified same-problem other-user prior, recipient current unchanged

budget.overflow: Retain both attempted slots as resource failures, never truncate or drop recipient.
budget.note: Each arm has the same draw and context/output caps, not necessarily equal prompt lengths. Within-new-experiment comparisons are2-vs2 draws; the old8-draw bank is only a reference.

preconditions_before_empirical_release: Freeze full recipient/observed-source/donor/HS assignments and authenticate all public feedback and sample identities; do not select recipients from newly favorable outcomes.
Materialize all-arm exact prompts and measure final chat-template token counts with the frozen local tokenizer; retain all overflow cases.

Implement an out-of-bank scoring bridge using each saved C_joint fold model and its exact saved scaler/feature extraction. Existing candidate-score maps do not contain new candidate IDs and cannot be reused as if they did. No refit or score imputation.
Freeze the matched generation/runtime/candidate execution resource release and independently verify the input and scoring bridge before GPU launch.
New candidates require separately sealed evaluator coverage; do not reuse private labels for different code. Complete and seal selections before full-suite assessment.
Keep existing correctness/regression/unknown gates and clearly distinguish adaptive development from a later untouched confirmation.
claim_boundary: Aligned changes/outcomes are observed associations, not causal attribution, learner skill or an appropriate next learning step. Current implementation has synthetic coverage only; no empirical performance is attributed to it.
